instruction: Grab the block-shaped seal with angled edges using the left arm and stamp Blue

source.instruction: Grab the block-shaped seal with angled edges using the left arm and stamp Blue

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the seal, which was at x = -24 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm above the seal to (-24, -2, 89) and point down.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+6, +17, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -3, 89) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=79.5 and grasp the seal.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the seal; closed the gripper (opening 0.52: holding the seal)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -3, 80) opening 0.52; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift seal slightly to z=84.5 to clear table.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +4) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-24, -3, 84) opening 0.53; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift further and translate left gripper above the blue target at (-15, 4, 89).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +6, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-15, 4, 89) opening 0.53; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower seal onto blue pad to stamp it, then open gripper.
